fact: A post-enumeration survey in August 2024 found a 4.3% undercount (1,973,933 persons), and the NPHC 2024 final report was released on 31 December 2024 with subject-specific thematic reports to follow by June 2025.
title: National Population and Housing Census 2024, Acholi Sub Region, County and Subcounty Profile, Volume 2
